n = int(input())
A = list(map(int, input().split()))

ret = 0
for i, a in enumerate(A):
    if i < a:
        j = next(j for j in range(n-1, i, -1) if A[j] < a)
        A[i], A[j] = A[j], A[i]
        ret += 1

print(ret)
